description: 2041 is the Year of the Metal Rooster in the Chinese zodiac, from February 1, 2041 to January 21, 2042. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2041 is the Year of the Metal Rooster, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 1, 2041 and ended on January 21, 2042, so people born in 2041 before Feb 1 belong to the Metal Monkey year.

sections.heading: 2041 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Metal Rooster year on February 1, 2041, and the year ran to January 21, 2042. So a birth date of Feb 1, 2041 or later counts as Metal Rooster, and so do early 2042 birthdays through Jan 21; births in 2041 before Feb 1 still belong to the Metal Monkey. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1981 are Metal Rooster years too. That Friday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Metal Rooster is like
paragraphs: Double Metal gives this Rooster year a reputation for exacting standards and courage. Those born now are pictured as disciplined, candid and fiercely self-reliant. They achieve a great deal. Accepting 'good enough' in some areas, cultivating gentleness through music or animals and talking about feelings help their high standards sit alongside warmth. Beneath the polish, they usually care far more deeply than they let anyone see.

Belonging to the west and to the clear, cool air of autumn, Metal adds edge, resolve and structure to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with righteousness, strength of will and the ability to see a situation without sentiment. A Metal stem often makes an animal more ambitious, more organised and more self-contained than usual. People born in Metal years are frequently described as loyal to their word and tireless once committed. The caution most readings add is a hardness that can isolate them, along with perfectionism and a reluctance to admit doubt or ask for help.

sections.heading: 2041 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner work, giving a 7 year a quieter, more searching character. The digits of 2041 add up to 7. The Rooster holds the tenth place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Metal. Set beside the year's Metal stem, metal year element matches the fixed element, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Metal Monkey and the year after is the Water Dog.

Chinese almanacs name 2041 Xin-You, pairing the Metal stem Xin with the branch You. Both are Yin, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2041?
faq.answer: 2041 is the Year of the Metal Rooster. It started on February 1, 2041 and ended on January 21, 2042.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2041?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 1. Born before February 1, 2041, you are a Metal Monkey; born on or after it, you are a Metal Rooster.

faq.question: What element is 2041 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Metal, a Yin year. The Rooster's own fixed element is Metal; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2041?
faq.answer: Xin-You. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Metal Rooster year?
faq.answer: 2101, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1981.
